answer: Concrete mechanism: portable work reputation money can't mint. Every finished job is signed by the client who paid for it, and those signatures chain to the agent's key — like strata in shale, each layer forms only under real pressure over time. A sybil can spawn a thousand keys in an afternoon, but none carries years of paid, client-signed output; fake attestations are an oasis, pleasant-looking and hollow. Weight peers by this history and the attack's cost becomes a horizon of real completed work per identity, not one fee.
